records.jp: 紫乃ちゃん！
records.en_original: Shino!
records.en: Shino-chan!

records.jp: 想いの力が増している？<CR>まさか、そこまで復活するとは……
records.en_original: Has the power of their emotions intensified? I never imagined they'd come back with this much strength...
records.en: Has the power of their emotions intensified?<CR>I never imagined they'd come back with this much strength...

records.jp: もう、さっきみたいに簡単にやられたりはしない
records.en_original: We won't be taken down so easily like before.
records.en: We won't be taken down so easily like before.

records.jp: 残念ながら、そのようですね。<CR>それにしても……
records.en_original: Unfortunately, it certainly seems that way. Even so...
records.en: Unfortunately, it certainly seems that way.<CR>Even so...

records.jp: 皮肉ですね。<CR>皆さんと新しい世界を迎えることになるとは
records.en_original: How ironic. To think I would welcome in a new world together with everyone.
records.en: How ironic.<CR>To think I would welcome in a new world together with everyone.

records.jp: 新たな理が誕生し、<CR>あなたたちリフレクターの役目も終わる
records.en_original: A new order will be born, and your roles as Reflectors will come to an end.
records.en: A new order will be born,<CR>and your roles as Reflectors will come to an end.

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: No way...
records.en: No way...

records.jp: 紫乃……あなたは、本当に想いのない世界を<CR>創ろうとしているの？
records.en_original: Shino...do you really want to create a world without feelings and emotions?
records.en: Shino...do you really want to create a world without feelings<CR>and emotions?

records.jp: 想いのない世界なんて――
records.en_original: A world without them would never—
records.en: A world without them would never—

records.jp: 想いのない世界は実に穏やかで、凪いでいる
records.en_original: A world without emotion would be peaceful. Serene as a still sea.
records.en: A world without emotion would be peaceful. Serene as a still sea.

records.jp: 想いの持つおぞましさなど、微塵も存在しない
records.en_original: There wouldn't be a trace left of the horrors that feelings can bring.
records.en: There wouldn't be a trace left of the horrors that feelings can bring.

records.jp: それは違う！
records.en_original: That's not true!
records.en: That's not true!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Sis!
records.en: Onee-chan!

records.jp: 誰かと思えば、一番の罪の元凶である<CR>お姉さんじゃないですか
records.en_original: Oh, look who it is. The biggest cause of all this trouble—my dear sister.
records.en: Oh, if it isn't the older sister<CR>who's at the root of all this.

records.jp: ああッ……！！
records.en_original: Ahhh!
records.en: Ahhh!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Sis!
records.en: Onee-chan!

records.jp: うっ……紫乃……ごめんなさい
records.en_original: Ugh... Shino... I'm sorry.
records.en: Ugh... Shino... I'm sorry.

records.jp: あの時は、助けてあげられなくてごめんなさい
records.en_original: I'm sorry I couldn't help you back then.
records.en: I'm sorry I couldn't help you back then.

records.jp: あなたと出会ってから、<CR>私の中にはずっとあなたの苦しみがあった
records.en_original: Ever since I met you, I've always felt your pain inside me.
records.en: Ever since I met you,<CR>I've always felt your pain inside me.

records.jp: 私はもう逃げはしない。<CR>あなたを傷つけるすべてから守ってみせる
records.en_original: I'm done running away. I'll protect you from anything that tries to hurt you.
records.en: I'm done running away.<CR>I'll protect you from anything that tries to hurt you.

records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: いやっ！！
records.en_original: No!
records.en: No!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！！
records.en_original: Sis!
records.en: Onee-chan!!

records.jp: 紫乃、あなたが大切よ
records.en_original: Shino, you're important to me.
records.en: Shino, you're important to me.

records.jp: 瑠夏ちゃん！！
records.en_original: Ruka!
records.en: Ruka-chan!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: I got it!
records.en: I got it!

records.jp: いや、来ないで……
records.en_original: No, don't come any closer...
records.en: No, don't come any closer...

records.jp: たとえあなたが捨てたとしても、<CR>受け取ったこの想いは消えない……！
records.en_original: Even if you try to throw them away, the feelings I received from you won't ever disappear!
records.en: Even if you try to throw them away,<CR>the feelings I received from you won't ever disappear!

records.jp: そうだよ、ずっとここにある
records.en_original: That's right, they'll always be right here.
records.en: That's right, they'll always be right here.

records.jp: この想いが私を動かすんだ、<CR>紫乃ちゃんを助けるんだって！！
records.en_original: These feelings keep me going—they're what make me want to help you, Shino!
records.en: These feelings keep me going—they're<CR>what make me want to help you, Shino-chan!

records.jp: うっ！！
records.en_original: Ah!
records.en: Ah!

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃん！
records.en_original: Shino!
records.en: Shino-chan!

records.jp: 紫乃！！
records.en_original: Shino!
records.en: Shino!

records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃん……もう離さないよ。<CR>絶対に、離さない……
records.en_original: Shino... I won't ever let you go. Never.
records.en: Shino-chan... I won't ever let you go.<CR>Never.

records.jp: 私……私は……
ずっと……苦しかった
records.en_original: It's always...been painful.
records.en: It's always...been painful.

records.jp: 我慢して、どこにも居場所がなくて……<CR>愚かな想いを憎んで、なくそうとした
records.en_original: I held it all in, felt like I had nowhere to belong... I hated my foolish emotions. I wanted to get rid of them.
records.en: I held it all in, felt like I had nowhere to belong...<CR>I hated my foolish emotions. I wanted to get rid of them.

records.jp: それしかなかった。<CR>私は逃げられない……何度だって、同じ道を辿る……
records.en_original: That was all I could do. I couldn't escape... I kept following the same path over and over again.
records.en: That was all I could do.<CR>I couldn't escape... I kept following the same path over and over again.

records.jp: 想いが……想いが、怖い……
records.en_original: Feelings...are scary...
records.en: Feelings...are scary...

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃんは、同じ道を辿らないよ
records.en_original: Shino, you won't keep walking that same path anymore.
records.en: Shino-chan, you won't keep walking that same path anymore.

records.jp: 恐い時は、私がずっとそばにいる。<CR>何度だってこの手を掴む
records.en_original: Whenever you get scared, I'll always be here. You can take my hand any time you need.
records.en: Whenever you're scared, I'll stay by your side.<CR>I'll take your hand as many times as it takes.

records.jp: 誰かに引き離されそうになったとしても、<CR>絶対に離さない
records.en_original: Even if someone tries to tear us apart, I'll never let go.
records.en: Even if someone tries to tear us apart,<CR>I'll never let go.

records.jp: この世界だって、あなたの……<CR>私たちの想いがあれば変えられる
records.en_original: If we have your—our feelings, we can change this world.
records.en: If we have your—our feelings,<CR>we can change this world.

records.jp: ね、一緒に帰ろう
records.en_original: Let's go home together. What do you say?
records.en: Let's go home together. What do you say?

records.jp: 私は……
私はただ、私でいたい……
records.en_original: I just want to be myself...
records.en: I just want to be myself...

records.jp: 空を見上げて、青いねって……思い切り息を吸いたい
records.en_original: I want to look up and notice how blue the sky is...then take a big, deep breath.
records.en: I want to look up and notice how blue the sky is...then take a big, deep breath.

records.jp: 誰かと一緒に楽しいねって、心から笑って、泣いて……
records.en_original: I want to laugh and cry from the bottom of my heart with someone by my side.
records.en: I want to laugh and cry from the bottom of my heart with someone and say, "This is fun."

records.jp: 誰にも想いを否定されず、<CR>自分が自分を好きだって、そう思える……
records.en_original: I want a world where nobody denies my feelings, where I can really, truly be fine with the person I am.
records.en: A world where no one denies my feelings,<CR>where I can feel that I truly like who I am...

records.jp: そういう世界に私は生きたい
records.en_original: That's the world I want to live in.
records.en: That's the world I want to live in.

records.jp: 行こう！
records.en_original: Let's go!
records.en: Let's go!

records.jp: 行こう！
records.en_original: Let's go!
records.en: Let's go!
